digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule selection in pyproject.toml after resolving all existing violations.

Validate timestamp semantics as UTC in validate_checks.py: epoch seconds use datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(..., tz=datetime.timezone.utc), timezone-less strings use datetime.datetime.strptime(...).replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).
Prove UTC timezone invariance of timestamp clustering behavior under multiple TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms using time.tzset().
Preserve security-pin cadence as host-local calendar date by obtaining an aware instant with explicit timezone and converting to host timezone before extracting date.
Prohibit the literal datetime.UTC token in production src/rebar code; enforce use of datetime.timezone.utc for py310 target-version compatibility.
Resolve drift-introduced ASYNC and DTZ violations in test files (test_jira_onboard.py DTZ001, test_review_bot.py ASYNC110/ASYNC251) before landing the ratchet.
